search_notes: BURAN. Re-check confirms the first trace. Adlai Nortye Form 6-K dated 30 May 2025 (opened): "The study did not meet the primary endpoint of improving overall survival compared to paclitaxel alone", no numbers. Looked for an earlier disclosure and found none: EDGAR full-text search shows only three Adlai filings naming buparlisib after Sept 2024 (20-F of 30 Apr 2025, 20-F/A of 12 May 2025, this 6-K); the 20-F of 30 Apr 2025 (opened) says "We expect to release the topline results of the Phase III clinical trial in the second quarter of 2025"; the company's GlobeNewswire list has no BURAN release in 2025. HR from ESMO 2025 (LBA48) coverage dated 20 Oct 2025 (OS 9.6 vs 9.7 mo, HR 1.02, 95% CI 0.83-1.26, p=0.85); session day within 17-21 Oct not confirmed, other outlets are dated 21 Oct. Disclosure is five months before the registry "actual" primary completion date.

AK104-302 (COMPASSION-15). Re-check confirms the first trace. Akeso HKEX voluntary announcement of 7 Nov 2023 07:00 (opened): reached the primary endpoint of OS at a prespecified interim analysis, "statistically significant and clinically meaningful", no numbers; the trial continued, so coded met rather than stopped_efficacy. Nothing earlier: the HKEX title list for Akeso (9926) from 1 Aug to 31 Dec 2023 has no other AK104-302 notice before it. HR first public at AACR 2024: OncLive article dated 7 Apr 2024 prints "HR, 0.6; 95% CI, 0.5-0.78" (mOS 15.0 vs 10.8 mo, p<0.001); Akeso's own release of 8 Apr 2024 (akesobio.com/en/media/akeso-news/240408/) gives HR=0.62, which is the value recorded; the 2023 annual results of 18 Mar 2024 give no HR. Registry "actual" primary completion date is 13 months after the disclosure.

AK105-303 (penpulimab vs chemotherapy, r/r cHL, 60 patients). No result found. Registry: status unknown, not updated since Feb 2022, no results. Europe PMC by NCT and by penpulimab + Hodgkin: only the single-arm AK105-201 paper (2022) and an unrelated 2026 combination study. Akeso HKEX results announcements for H1 2024, FY2024, H1 2025, FY2025 and H1 2026 (all downloaded and searched for AK105-303, cHL, Hodgkin): cHL appears only as the indication approved in Aug 2021, no phase 3 readout. One Chinese-language web search (drug name, indication, study number): registry entries only (Chinese registry CTR20211254 shown as recruiting). Estimated primary completion date was 2025-12-30.

ASC40-301. Re-check leaves the first trace as it was: no source states an endpoint result. Ascletis 2025 interim results (HKEX, 15 Aug 2025, opened): "After analysis of ASC40 Phase III study for rGBM, the Group decided to terminate this program" - nothing on PFS or OS. Earlier Ascletis documents opened: FY2023 results (25 Mar 2024: 120 patients enrolled, likely enough events for the PFS interim analysis), H1 2024 results (30 Aug 2024: milestone "complete Phase III"), FY2024 results (26 Mar 2025: "seek opportunities to maximize the value of this program"); the FY2025 results (31 Mar 2026) and H1 2026 results no longer mention rGBM. No stand-alone rGBM notice in the HKEX title list for Ascletis (1672), June 2023 to Oct 2026. Licensor Sagimet (SEC filer): investor presentations of Jan, Mar, May and Aug 2025 and the 10-Q for Q2 2025 still call the trial ongoing; its March 2026 presentation says only "Ascletis announced cessation of China GBM program in August 2025". Two web searches (English, Chinese) found no explicit result. Confidence is medium because the limit is what the source says, not the search. Lag from mid-month (registry date is month-only); registry not updated since Oct 2024.

which_endpoint: OS in PD-L1-high: durvalumab + chemotherapy vs chemotherapy (met); durvalumab + tremelimumab + chemotherapy vs chemotherapy (not met)
search_notes: NILE. No stand-alone release. AstraZeneca H1/Q2 2026 results announcement of 27 Jul 2026 (opened): milestone table says "NILE, 1L bladder cancer, Primary endpoint met"; the pipeline text, marked "Q2 2026, New disclosure", says one dual primary endpoint was met (Imfinzi plus chemotherapy, statistically significant OS improvement in PD-L1 high) and that Imfinzi plus Imjudo with chemotherapy "did not meet the other dual primary endpoint of OS" in the same population. CHANGED from the first trace (mixed) to met under the rule that one of several sufficient primary endpoints is enough; a reader who wants both arms should treat it as mixed. Source type recorded as press_release (a quarterly results release, as trace A treats them); the first trace called the same document an exchange announcement. Nothing earlier: EDGAR full-text search shows no AstraZeneca filing stating a NILE result before 27 Jul 2026 (the 29 May 2026 release, opened, says NILE "continues to be investigated"). No hazard ratio public: one web search found none, registry has no results.

which_endpoint: OS (overall population and PIK3CA/AKT1/PTEN-altered; dual primary, both missed)
search_notes: CAPItello-290. Re-check confirms the first trace. AstraZeneca announcement of 18 Jun 2024 (Form 6-K copy opened): "did not meet the dual primary endpoints of improvement in overall survival" in the overall population or the PIK3CA/AKT1/PTEN-altered subgroup, no numbers. Nothing earlier: the Q1 2024 clinical trials appendix (25 Apr 2024, opened) still lists CAPItello-290 among upcoming key phase III readouts. HR at ESMO 2024 (LBA19), coverage dated 13 Sep 2024: overall HR 0.92 (0.78-1.08, p=0.3239), altered subgroup HR 1.05 (0.77-1.43); same figures in the Ann Oncol paper (PMID 41422862, 19 Dec 2025). HR columns give the overall population. Registry primary completion date is still an estimated March 2026.

COMPEL. Disclosed at WCLC 2025 (6-9 Sept): OncLive article with a page date of 6 Sep 2025 (opened), median PFS 8.4 vs 4.4 mo, HR 0.43 (95% CI 0.27-0.70); ESMO Open paper published 8 Sep 2025 (PMID 41139117, full text read) and registry results posted 2026-01-13 give the same figures. The result cannot be coded met or not_met: the paper says that, after enrolment was cut to 98 patients, "the study was no longer powered to carry out a formal hypothesis test and a descriptive analysis for all efficacy endpoints was carried out" and the HR was "calculated without hypothesis testing"; the registry analysis has no p-value. So primary_result stays unclear (the interval excludes 1; a reader could argue met). Confidence is high for what was read, not for the coding. The presentation day is uncertain by up to two days (the paper is dated 8 Sept). Nothing earlier: no AstraZeneca SEC filing names COMPEL with Tagrisso, the 9M/Q3 2025 results announcement and appendix do not mention it, one web search found no earlier abstract. Data cut-off 28 Oct 2024 equals the registry primary completion date.

MONO-OLA1. Not read out as of 9 Oct 2026. AstraZeneca H1/Q2 2026 clinical trials appendix (27 Jul 2026, opened): "Data anticipated: H2 2026"; the H1/Q2 2026 results announcement does not mention the trial. EDGAR full-text search: the only AstraZeneca filing naming MONO-OLA1 since Oct 2025 is the 20-F of Feb 2026, and none of the nine AstraZeneca filings naming Lynparza between 1 Jul and 9 Oct 2026 is a MONO-OLA1 release (this closes the gap the first trace left for August to October 2026). Registry: active, not recruiting, estimated primary completion 2026-07-27, no results. Europe PMC and one web search: no result. Two primary endpoints (PFS in BRCAwt HRD-positive and in BRCAwt).

LATIFY. Re-check confirms the first trace. AstraZeneca announcement of 22 Dec 2025 (Form 6-K copy opened; same text as the release on astrazeneca.com cited by the first trace): "did not meet the primary endpoint of overall survival (OS) versus standard-of-care docetaxel", no numbers. Nothing earlier: the 9M/Q3 2025 clinical trials appendix (6 Nov 2025, opened) says "Data anticipated: H2 2025", the 9M/Q3 2025 results announcement does not mention LATIFY, and EDGAR full-text search finds no AstraZeneca filing naming LATIFY between June 2025 and 22 Dec 2025. HR at ELCC 2026 (LBA1, listed for 27 Mar 2026): OncoDaily article dated 27 Mar 2026, HR 0.90 (95% CI 0.75-1.09, p=0.287), median OS 11.1 vs 10.0 mo.

GBMT-209-P04 (BEBT-209 + fulvestrant). No result found. Registry: recruiting, last updated May 2025, no results. Europe PMC: only the phase 1 paper (Breast, July 2025). Sponsor is listed in Shanghai (688759), not Hong Kong: its 2025 annual report summary (28 Apr 2026, opened) and the sponsor-broker supervision report for H1 2026 (Sept 2026, opened) describe BEBT-209 only as in a phase IIb/III programme with chemotherapy for triple-negative breast cancer and a phase Ib with BEBT-908; neither names the fulvestrant phase 3 or any readout. Two Chinese-language web searches: registry entries only (Chinese registry CTR20220426 shown as recruiting). The trial has dropped out of the sponsor's pipeline description without explanation; it may have been deprioritised, but no source says it was stopped.

ICP-CL-00111 (orelabrutinib vs chlorambucil + rituximab, first-line CLL/SLL). Earliest explicit result found: InnoCare FY2025 annual results (HKEX, 25 Mar 2026, opened): median PFS not reached vs 19.4 mo, HR 0.32 (95% CI 0.18-0.58), p<0.0001; the text misnames the comparator as bendamustine plus rituximab. Paper 6 Jul 2026 (Signal Transduct Target Ther, PMID 42402625, full text read): efficacy boundary crossed at the prespecified interim analysis reviewed 17 May 2024; enrolment was already complete, so coded met. AN EARLIER DISCLOSURE MAY EXIST BUT WAS NOT FOUND: opened and searched the H1 2024 results (20 Aug 2024), Q3 2024 report, FY2024 results (27 Mar 2025: "trial has been finished", NDA submitted), the approval notice of 25 Apr 2025, the Q1 2025 report, H1 2025 results and Q3 2025 report - none states a result; trade coverage of the approval (25 Apr 2025) gives only a complete response rate. The approval itself (25 Apr 2025) implies a positive trial without stating it. Crossref, Europe PMC and three web searches (English and Chinese) found no ASH, EHA or CSCO abstract before March 2026; the Chinese label and Shanghai-exchange-only filings were not read.

MIL62-CT301 (MIL62 + lenalidomide vs lenalidomide, rituximab-refractory FL). No result found. Registry: recruiting, last updated Nov 2024, no results. Europe PMC and Crossref: only the single-arm phase 1b/2 paper (EClinicalMedicine 2024, PMID 39007066). Two Chinese-language web searches: no readout; two news reports of 11 Aug 2026 on the sponsor's listing prospectus (opened) say MIL62 is still "in phase III" in follicular lymphoma, with approvals only in NMOSD (Feb 2026) and membranous nephropathy (June 2026). Sponsor is not listed in Hong Kong; the prospectus itself was not opened. Beware the sponsor's other MIL62 phase 3 readouts (NMOSD, membranous nephropathy), which are different trials.

BESTPOP (icaritin vs huachansu, enriched HCC). No result found. Registry: status unknown, last updated Aug 2024, no results. Europe PMC by NCT, acronym and icaritin: nothing on this trial. Sponsor site reachable over plain http (www.shenogen.com): company-news and media-news lists read back to 2022 (latest item 1 Jul 2026) contain no BESTPOP, huachansu or phase 3 readout item. Two web searches (Chinese, English): registry entries only. Sponsor is unlisted. Beware the earlier icaritin phase 3 trials (NCT03236636, NCT03236649), which are different studies.

BH-OH2-020 (OH2 oncolytic virus, melanoma, OS). No result found. Registry: recruiting, last updated Jul 2025, estimated primary completion 2026-03, no results. Europe PMC: only the phase 1a/1b paper (J Immunother Cancer, Feb 2025). Two Chinese-language web searches: no interim or final OS readout and no marketing application; news reports of 3-4 Apr 2026 and 4 Sep 2026 on the sponsor's Hong Kong listing application (opened) still describe BS001/OH2 as a clinical-stage phase III candidate. Sponsor is not yet listed; the listing document itself was not opened.
